text:
tina: Heads-up — after the int8 bring-up on veridian-lite last night we're seeing token splits on CJK suffixes around ZWNJ-like chars. BLEU on our zh->en set dropped ~1.8 points :eyes:
jiayi: ugh, repro case?
otar: link to the failing sample?
tina: quick sample: 
```
src: 我爱编程（Note: there is a narrow no-break whitespace + ZWNJ-like char inserted by OCR）
ref: I love programming.
pred (q8): I love programming.
pred (int8): I love program ming .
```
ome: spacing + a bogus split in the middle of 编程 -> program ming
omar: can you paste the tokenization output? which tokenizer version?
tina: token ids: qtok.encode('我爱编程') -> [4512, 893, 12033, 0, 0xEFB, ...] (weird 0xEFB surrogate)
jiayi: that surrogate looks like a kerning/zero-width artifact. did the quant kernels change the detokenizer mapping?
alex: i checked runtime diff: kernel selector switched to fused-decode for shortctx on int8; might be using a different merge table for bytepair merges.
ci-bot: [deploy] veridian-lite-int8 canary deployed to staging at 2026-03-20T23:12:04Z
jiayi: can we bisect between the last good (q8) and this int8 build? any PR that touched detok or tokenmap?
eva: assigning bisect -> i'll check tokenmap/regression tests and add a quick smoke that runs detok on a mixed CJK + ZWSP set. expected: no mid-word splits.
omar: also add an eval run that compares prefix-preservation (new metric) across q8,q4f16,int8. need numbers before we decide rollback.
tina: current quick numbers on our small devset: q8 BLEU=34.7, q4f16=34.1, int8=32.9. suffix-preservation metric: q8=0.998, q4f16=0.995, int8=0.963.
jiayi: ok please include one-or-two failing sentences with raw bytes attached so ops can reproduce, and link the commit hash.
eva: creating ticket and adding to eng-ml board. tagging @alex for kernel review, @omar for tokenizer tests.
alex: i'll start by diffing the vocabulary merge table in the artifact (int8 build) vs q8 artifact. also adding detok fuzzer.
tina: thanks — for now i've pinned the dedicated canary routing to q4f16 for the affected locale to reduce customer impact. :thumbsup:
jiayi: thanks, team. once we have bisect result we'll decide on mitigation (kernel tweak vs detok patch vs fallback policy). :thinking:
